quota.details: Current Developer plan includes a one-time 1,000,000-character credit; it does not reset monthly. The retired API Free plan's former 500,000/month allowance is not currently purchasable. Paid Growth/Enterprise plans have separate included and usage-based pricing.

rate_limits.details: Per-request limits and account usage limits vary; check current plan docs. HTTP 456 indicates quota exhausted and should not be retried.

license.service: DeepL API Terms and plan-specific terms apply.
license.data: Translation outputs and use rights follow DeepL terms; included credits do not create an unlimited service license.
license.notes: Growth advertises no data training; do not assume that same guarantee for every plan.

sdk.name: deepl
sdk.status: Official DeepL Python client library.

records.privacy: Text is transmitted to DeepL for processing. Current Growth pricing advertises no data training and deletion after processing; the free Developer plan does not show that same promise in the reviewed table. Do not send sensitive text without confirming plan terms.

cors.notes: DeepL says not to use API keys in client-side code; browser CORS behavior was not verified.

records.name: LibreTranslate (self-hosted software; hosted instances vary)
records.summary: Open-source machine-translation server. The public libretranslate.com instance has its own key/pricing requirements; this record describes self-hosting, not a free hosted endpoint.

endpoints.purpose: Translate text; API key requirement depends on the instance configuration.

authentication.notes: Authentication varies by instance. This record does not assume that the public host accepts a particular API-key header or query method. Review current instance documentation; configure custom catalog auth for a self-hosted or paid endpoint.

quota.details: Self-host software is available under AGPLv3; compute, hosting, language packs, and configured limits are the operator's responsibility. The public hosted service is not represented as free.

rate_limits.details: Self-hosted key limits are operator-configured; official docs show examples, not a universal hosted quota.

license.service: LibreTranslate server is AGPLv3; public hosting has separate terms.
license.data: Translation model and language-pack licenses can vary; check each installed model.
license.notes: AGPL obligations can apply when modifying or providing the software as a network service.

sdk.name: REST/HTTP
sdk.status: Official API docs include a basic JSON request; this package makes no claim about a maintained Python SDK.

records.privacy: Self-hosting keeps traffic under the operator's control subject to their infrastructure; hosted instances receive text submitted for translation. Avoid sensitive text on third-party instances.

cors.notes: CORS depends on the selected server configuration; not verified as a universal capability.

records.name: Twilio Programmable Messaging API
records.summary: Paid communications API. Destination, channel, sender, and country affect costs and throughput.

endpoints.purpose: Create an outbound message resource; replace AccountSid with the account identifier.

authentication.notes: HTTP Basic authentication; never log or expose either value. Sending messages may incur charges and has external side effects.

quota.details: Messaging is priced by destination/channel and account configuration; no free recurring API tier is asserted. Review current regional pricing before sending.

rate_limits.details: Throughput depends on sender type, destination, and account configuration; no universal limit is asserted in the reviewed Message resource page.

license.service: Twilio service terms and messaging policies apply.
license.data: Message content and recipient data are personal data; message transmission and retention are governed by Twilio terms and applicable laws.
license.notes: Use only with the necessary recipient consent and lawful basis.

sdk.name: twilio-python
sdk.status: Official Twilio Python helper library.

records.privacy: Twilio's Message resource marks body content as PII with a 30-day retention label. Messages contain recipient and content data; minimize collection and review regional privacy/retention terms.

cors.notes: Messaging credentials are server-side; browser CORS behavior was not established in the reviewed endpoint page.

endpoints.purpose: Submit an input query using an AppID; responses may be XML or other documented formats.

authentication.notes: AppID required; keep it out of shared URLs, source code, and logs.

quota.details: Official pricing page advertises a free non-commercial development account, but the numeric free query allowance was not verified. Paid standard pricing lists $25 per 1,000 queries for Simple/Short Answers/Instant Calculator and $50 per 1,000 for Full Results; confirm current plan and commercial rights.

rate_limits.details: No numeric free-account rate limit was established in the reviewed docs.

license.service: Wolfram|Alpha API terms and plan-specific restrictions apply.
license.data: Returned results may contain source-attributed or copyrighted material; obey the API terms and attribution requirements.
license.notes: Free development plan is stated as non-commercial; commercial use needs an appropriate paid license.

sdk.name: REST/HTTP
sdk.status: No provider-maintained Python SDK verified in the reviewed pages.
